question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?
sql: SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name, AVG(pl.qty) as avg_units_picked FROM picking_line pl JOIN products p ON pl.product_id = p.id WHERE pl.order_id = 421 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id
